platform: Cloud SaaS and web-based SIS with native iOS and Android family apps; no current desktop client or on-premise deployment documented.

distinctive_features.feature: FACTS IQ connects SIS, admissions, finance, engagement, and analytics data.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can link applicant, family, academic, and financial workflows while reducing duplicate data entry.

distinctive_features.feature: Dashboard Builder provides configurable, shareable dashboards using live SIS data.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: School leaders can examine operational data without relying solely on exported spreadsheets.

distinctive_features.feature: Admissions analytics cover yield, retention, affordability, and financial-aid impact.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Admissions teams can assess enrollment patterns alongside financial factors.

distinctive_features.feature: Medical and behavior workflows share student records, including medication scheduling, incidents, interventions, and family alerts.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can coordinate health and behavior documentation with academic and family records.

distinctive_features.feature: Public OneRoster 1.1 API documents OAuth access and roster resources.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools have a documented path to exchange roster data with compatible systems.

distinctive_features.feature: Family App combines grades, attendance, homework, announcements, schedules, medical information, and tuition access.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Families can reach common school information and payment functions through a mobile hub.

distinctive_features.feature: Cafeteria tools include menus, prepaid balances, POS barcode scanning, and lunch activity.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Schools can connect lunch operations with student and family workflows.

weaknesses.issue: Pricing is quote-only, with no published SIS rate or standard implementation fee.
Reviewers report a learning curve, click-heavy navigation, bugs, outages, and difficult reports.
Some reviewers describe clunky reports, limited trend views, and unclear roadmap communication.
Family App reviewers report forced reauthentication, password resets, delayed grades, crashes, and confusing navigation.
Email delivery, authentication, repeated logins, account synchronization, and support handoffs have prompted complaints.
Transport, library, boarding, payroll, and IEP management are not clearly documented as native U.S. SIS modules.
The broader ecosystem can involve multiple products and logins, with setup work and a learning curve.
Public U.S. documentation does not enumerate all state or federal reporting templates.

ai_features: FACTS advertises admissions yield predictions and AI-supported pattern detection and proactive alerts as roadmap capabilities; a production conversational assistant is not documented.
pricing_model_summary: No public SIS price card; sales quotation required. Family App is listed at $4.99 per family annually; a third-party API connection is reported at $500 annually.
biggest_strategic_gap: Native depth is unclear for transport, library, boarding, payroll, IEP management, and jurisdiction-specific reporting; broad capabilities also span connected products rather than one SIS module.
